taglines.genesis: The book of beginnings: God makes a good world, humanity breaks it, and God promises to bless every nation through one family.
taglines.exodus: The book of Israel's rescue from slavery in Egypt, the covenant God makes with them at Mount Sinai, and the tent where he comes to live among them.
taglines.leviticus: How a holy God can live among an unholy people: sacrifice, priesthood, purity, and a whole life set apart for him and for the neighbor.
taglines.numbers: The book of the wilderness: a people counted and ordered around God's presence refuses to trust him, dies in the desert, and leaves its children at the edge of the promised land.
taglines.deuteronomy: Moses' farewell sermons on the plains of Moab: the covenant restated for a new generation, calling Israel to love the one God with the whole heart before it enters the land.
taglines.joshua: The book of the promised land: Israel crosses the Jordan under Joshua, takes hold of Canaan, divides it among the tribes, and renews the covenant with God.
taglines.judges: The dark years between Joshua and the kings, when Israel kept forgetting God and God kept raising up flawed deliverers to rescue them.
